x.content: Reading 資治通鑑 in the original shouldn't mean losing the thread. I made six free B&W parts with 文言文 beside English, modern Japanese, and modern Chinese. Read them here: https://lachlanchen.github.io/LinguaLeaf/website/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=wenyan_history

instagram.content:
Some books are difficult because the language is distant—not because the ideas are.

I’ve been building a free reading shelf where 文言文 sits beside English, modern Japanese, and modern Chinese. It includes 資治通鑑, 漢書, 後漢書, 三國志裴松之注, and 春秋左氏傳. Formats vary by title: 資治通鑑 currently has six black-and-white parts; several other histories offer both color and black-and-white readers.

Made with PocketPolyglot:
https://lachlanchen.github.io/LinguaLeaf/website/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=wenyan_history
